potato.weed_working_assumption: robot travels between ridges; potato haulm may be gently displaced; weed is gripped/cut beside crop plant

mission.primary: repeated autonomous weed control between crop plants and rows
mission.style: regular maintenance analogous to robotic mower
mission.treatment_zone: cultivated crop areas only; fallow excluded from weed treatment
mission.crop_interaction_model: crop damage risk is side contact, bending or tool intrusion, not normal driving between rows

geometry_pending: exact tool side offset relative to potato stems
crop haulm bending force and damage threshold
soil sinkage and traction parameters for heavy marsh soil

implemented_virtual_fixtures.potato_ridge: five 62 cm rows, 15 cm ridge height, visual potato haulm dummies, weeds in furrows; simple rigid collision/contact proxies
implemented_virtual_fixtures.tracked_overrow_high_clearance: 72 cm track-center gauge, 12 cm tracks, 48 cm nominal body clearance for straddling a potato row
implemented_virtual_fixtures.tracked_inrow_narrow: 34 cm track-center gauge, about 42 cm total width, 21 cm nominal body clearance for driving in narrow furrows
implemented_virtual_fixtures.tracked_overrow_belt08: 62 cm track-center gauge, 8 cm tracks, 48 cm nominal body clearance; current default for potato row visual testing
implemented_virtual_fixtures.tracked_overrow_belt06: 62 cm track-center gauge, 6 cm tracks, 48 cm nominal body clearance; narrow traction/bodendruck limit case
